summary: International Gojri Maa Boli Adab - A poetry website with collections, search, optional login system with Internet Identity, in-app notifications for new poetry (for logged-in users), and download buttons for poetry content (images direct download, text poetry converted to image format for download)
architectural_notes: Uses Internet Identity for optional authentication
In-app notification system for logged-in users (free, no email notifications)

existing_features.title: Implement optional Internet Identity login system that allows users to browse all content without logging in, but enables notifications when logged in
Add in-app notification system that displays alerts to logged-in users when new poetry is added to the platform
Add download button for image-type poems that enables direct image file download
Add download button for text-type poems that converts the text content into an image format (poster/card style) and downloads it
Update website title and branding from 'International Gojri Maa Booli Adab' to 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab' in both the browser tab title and header display

new_feature_requests.summary: Optional login system using Internet Identity - users can browse without login but logged-in users get notifications
In-app notification system (free) - show notifications to logged-in users when new poetry is added
Download buttons for poetry - direct image download for image poetry, convert text poetry to image format for download
